name: Capitalize Words
description: Capitalize the first letter of every word without changing anything else — entirely in your browser.

faq.question: How is this different from Title Case?
faq.answer: Title Case lowercases the rest of each word before capitalizing the first letter. Capitalize Words only touches each word's first letter and leaves everything else exactly as you typed it — so 'heLLo woRLd' becomes 'HeLLo WoRLd', not 'Hello World'.

faq.question: Is my text uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No — the conversion runs entirely in your browser with plain JavaScript. Nothing is sent to a server.
